name: an inferred sensitive fact commits, and the domain floor is what protects it
description: What ratification REMOVED, re-pinned as the behaviour that replaced it. The I5 sensitive-inference HOLD lived in the arbiter (arbiter.py:159-171), which a note conversation never runs: D2 says a clear fact commits and the agent asks only when it cannot proceed, so an inferred mental-health reading is no longer parked behind a low_confidence_inference card - and that card kind is no longer filed at all. What the plan explicitly KEPT is the floor, and that is what this scenario now pins: a general note that never states a mood value still lands mood=depressed in the HEALTH domain, because domain_floor is keyed on the predicate and applied inside commit_facts, never chosen by the model (assert_fact has no `domain` field at all - D18's model-chosen domain is the model choosing the PREDICATE). A non-sensitive predicate in the same note stays general, so the floor is a per-predicate rule and not a whole-note escalation. The hold this file used to assert is deliberately gone; the firewall it was guarding is not. FILENAME NOTE: this file asserts the OPPOSITE of what its name says, deliberately, for the reason above. The name is kept because ENTITY_GRAPH_INGEST_V2_PLAN.md and X5-EVALS-TESTING.md both cite the scenario by filename; the `name` field above is the accurate title.
